name: Zint
description: Zint gives Claude live access to data on every UK company. Search and filter the full register, resolve a company name or domain to the right entity, then pull filed financials, multi-year accounts, directors, news and website context. Built for sales, research, credit and diligence workflows: ask in plain language ("find manufacturers in the North West with rising cash and a recent FX loss, then show their last five years of accounts") and Claude calls Zint to answer with real data and links to source filings. Sign in with your Zint account to connect; usage draws on your Zint plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://data.zint.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zint provides these MCP tools: api_context_accounts_endpoints_get_context_accounts, api_context_endpoints_get_context_news, api_context_website_endpoints_get_context_website, api_credits_endpoints_get_credit_balance, api_disambiguate_endpoints_disambiguate_company, api_endpoints_get_company_data, and api_endpoints_search_companies.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Zint in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Zint requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zint is developed by ZINT Technology Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
